editorial:
Imagine being a top fashion model who has to starve herself just to keep her job. That is where you find Haruka, who is totally exhausted and stressed out. Everything changes when she faints and suddenly starts hearing the thoughts of a random butcher named Anharu. It sounds like a weird sci-fi setup, but the vibe is actually very soft and sweet. You get to see two people who feel lonely in their own lives find a secret connection that nobody else understands. It is a slow burn that focuses more on feelings than big dramatic plot twists, making it feel like a cozy afternoon spend.

The acting is very natural, and the chemistry between the leads makes the telepathy part feel believable. While the pacing is a bit slow for some, it allows you to really care about their struggle since they are both already married. If you like quiet stories about forbidden love, you will love this. To get the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the pretty scenery, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with a partner.
endingExplained: As Haruka and Anharu grow closer, they have to face the reality that they cannot be together because of their spouses. They eventually realize that their telepathic bond was a way to wake up and feel alive again. Instead of destroying their families, they choose to accept their lives. They say a bittersweet goodbye, knowing they changed each other for the better, and they return to their partners with a new sense of peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartfelt stories about lonely people finding a connection.
